struct CommandError <: Exception
    message::String
end
fail(s) = throw(CommandError(s))
check(b, s) = b ? nothing : fail(s)
parsetime(s) = 60parse(Int, s[1:2])+parse(Int, s[4:5])
timetext(t) = lpad(string(div(t, 60)), 2, '0')*":"*lpad(string(t%60), 2, '0')
placename(i) = i==0 ? "D" : string(i)
notation(path) = join(["D"; string.(path); "D"], '-')
tenths(i) = "$(div(i,10)).$(i%10)"
struct Stop
    x::Int
    y::Int
    demand::Int
    service::Int
    opening::Int
    closing::Int
end
mutable struct Workbench
    depot::Union{Nothing,Tuple{Int,Int}}
    start::Int
    stops::Dict{Int,Stop}
    tour::Union{Nothing,Vector{Int}}
    routes::Union{Nothing,Vector{Vector{Int}}}
    capacity::Int
end
Workbench() = Workbench(nothing, 480, Dict{Int,Stop}(), nothing, nothing, 0)
stopids(w) = sort!(collect(keys(w.stops)))
coordinates(w, i) = i==0 ? w.depot : (w.stops[i].x, w.stops[i].y)
function distance(w, a, b)
    x, y=coordinates(w, a)
    u, v=coordinates(w, b)
    abs(x-u)+abs(y-v)
end
function pathlength(w, path)
    route=[0; path; 0]
    sum(distance(w, route[i], route[i+1]) for i in 1:(length(route)-1))
end
pathload(w, path) = sum((w.stops[i].demand for i in path); init = 0)
planlength(w) = sum(pathlength(w, path) for path in w.routes)
function normalize!(w)
    routes=[copy(path) for path in w.routes if !isempty(path)]
    for path in routes
        first(path)>last(path) && reverse!(path)
    end
    sort!(routes; by = minimum)
    w.routes=routes
end
function requiredepot(w)
    check(w.depot!==nothing, "no depot")
end
function requirestops(w)
    check(!isempty(w.stops), "no stops")
end
function requiretour(w)
    check(w.tour!==nothing, "no tour")
end
function requireplan(w)
    check(w.routes!==nothing, "no plan")
end
function requirecapacity(w, q)
    for id in stopids(w)
        check(w.stops[id].demand<=q, "stop $id demand $(w.stops[id].demand) exceeds capacity $q")
    end
end
function installtour!(w, label, path)
    w.tour=path
    println("$label: $(notation(path)) length $(pathlength(w,path))")
end
function planreport(w, heading)
    println("$heading, routes $(length(w.routes)), length $(planlength(w))")
    for (r, path) in enumerate(w.routes)
        println("route $r: $(notation(path)) load $(pathload(w,path)) length $(pathlength(w,path))")
    end
end
function simulate(w, path)
    visits=NTuple{6,Int}[]
    timestamp=w.start
    previous=0
    waiting=0
    service=0
    violations=0
    lateness=0
    for id in path
        stop=w.stops[id]
        arrival=timestamp+distance(w, previous, id)
        wait=stop.opening<0 ? 0 : max(0, stop.opening-arrival)
        late=stop.closing<0 ? 0 : max(0, arrival-stop.closing)
        beginning=arrival+wait
        timestamp=beginning+stop.service
        push!(visits, (id, arrival, wait, beginning, timestamp, late))
        waiting+=wait
        service+=stop.service
        violations+=late>0
        lateness+=late
        previous=id
    end
    (
        visits = visits,
        finish = timestamp+distance(w, previous, 0),
        travel = pathlength(w, path),
        wait = waiting,
        service = service,
        violations = violations,
        lateness = lateness,
    )
end
function firstreversal(w, path)
    around=[0; path; 0]
    for i in 1:(length(path)-1), j in (i+1):length(path)
        gain=distance(w, around[i], around[i+1])+distance(w, around[j+1], around[j+2])-distance(
            w,
            around[i],
            around[j+1],
        )-distance(w, around[i+1], around[j+2])
        gain>0 && return (i, j, gain)
    end
    nothing
end
function twoopt!(w, path; display = true)
    moves=0
    while true
        move=firstreversal(w, path)
        move===nothing && break
        i, j, gain=move
        display && println("reverse $(path[i])..$(path[j]) gain $gain")
        path[i:j]=reverse(path[i:j])
        moves+=1
    end
    moves
end
function firstsegment(w, path)
    n=length(path)
    around=[0; path; 0]
    for size in 1:3, i in 1:(n-size+1)
        rest=[path[1:(i-1)]; path[(i+size):end]]
        remaining=[0; rest; 0]
        firstid=path[i]
        lastid=path[i+size-1]
        removal=distance(w, around[i], firstid)+distance(w, lastid, around[i+size+1])-distance(
            w,
            around[i],
            around[i+size+1],
        )
        for j in 0:length(rest)
            j==i-1 && continue
            gain=removal-distance(w, remaining[j+1], firstid)-distance(w, lastid, remaining[j+2])+distance(
                w,
                remaining[j+1],
                remaining[j+2],
            )
            gain>0 && return (i, size, j, gain)
        end
    end
    nothing
end
function firstswap(w, path)
    before=pathlength(w, path)
    for i in 1:(length(path)-1), j in (i+1):length(path)
        changed=copy(path)
        changed[i], changed[j]=changed[j], changed[i]
        gain=before-pathlength(w, changed)
        gain>0 && return (i, j, gain)
    end
    nothing
end
function exacttour(w)
    ids=stopids(w)
    n=length(ids)
    full=(1<<n)-1
    costs=zeros(Int, full+1, n)
    for i in 1:n
        costs[1, i]=distance(w, ids[i], 0)
    end
    for mask in 1:(full-1), i in 1:n
        (mask & (1<<(i-1)))!=0 && continue
        costs[mask+1, i]=minimum(
            distance(w, ids[i], ids[j])+costs[(mask⊻(1<<(j-1)))+1, j] for
            j in 1:n if (mask & (1<<(j-1)))!=0
        )
    end
    cost=minimum(distance(w, 0, ids[i])+costs[(full⊻(1<<(i-1)))+1, i] for i in 1:n)
    path=Int[]
    current=0
    mask=full
    while mask!=0
        choice=first(
            i for i in 1:n if (mask & (1<<(i-1)))!=0 &&
                distance(w, current, ids[i])+costs[(mask⊻(1<<(i-1)))+1, i]==cost
        )
        mask ⊻= 1<<(choice-1)
        cost=costs[mask+1, choice]
        current=ids[choice]
        push!(path, current)
    end
    path
end
function spanningtree(w, vertices)
    tree=vertices[1:1]
    remaining=vertices[2:end]
    edges=NTuple{3,Int}[]
    while !isempty(remaining)
        weight, child, at=minimum(
            (distance(w, parent, child), child, at) for child in remaining for
            (at, parent) in enumerate(tree)
        )
        parent=tree[at]
        push!(edges, (parent, child, weight))
        push!(tree, child)
        filter!(!=(child), remaining)
    end
    edges
end
function sweeporder(w)
    function less(a, b)
        x, y=coordinates(w, a) .- w.depot
        u, v=coordinates(w, b) .- w.depot
        az=x==0 && y==0
        bz=u==0 && v==0
        az!=bz && return az
        az && return a<b
        ah=(y>0 || (y==0 && x>0)) ? 0 : 1
        bh=(v>0 || (v==0 && u>0)) ? 0 : 1
        ah!=bh && return ah<bh
        cross=x*v-y*u
        cross!=0 && return cross>0
        d=abs(x)+abs(y)
        e=abs(u)+abs(v)
        d!=e ? d<e : a<b
    end
    sort!(stopids(w); lt = less)
end
function savings!(w, q, limit)
    ids=stopids(w)
    if limit!==nothing
        for id in ids
            check(2distance(w, 0, id)<=limit, "stop $id too far for limit $limit")
        end
    end
    pairs=Tuple{Int,Int,Int}[]
    for (i, a) in enumerate(ids), b in ids[(i+1):end]
        saving=distance(w, 0, a)+distance(w, 0, b)-distance(w, a, b)
        saving>0 && push!(pairs, (-saving, a, b))
    end
    sort!(pairs)
    routes=[[id] for id in ids]
    merges=0
    for (_, a, b) in pairs
        r=findfirst(path->a in path, routes)
        t=findfirst(path->b in path, routes)
        r==t && continue
        firstpath=routes[r]
        secondpath=routes[t]
        a in (first(firstpath), last(firstpath)) && b in (first(secondpath), last(secondpath)) ||
            continue
        pathload(w, firstpath)+pathload(w, secondpath)<=q || continue
        merged=[
            first(firstpath)==a ? reverse(firstpath) : firstpath;
            last(secondpath)==b ? reverse(secondpath) : secondpath
        ]
        limit!==nothing && pathlength(w, merged)>limit && continue
        routes=[path for (i, path) in enumerate(routes) if i!=r && i!=t]
        push!(routes, merged)
        merges+=1
    end
    w.capacity=q
    w.routes=routes
    normalize!(w)
    planreport(w, "vrp: capacity $q, merges $merges")
end
function splitplan!(w, q)
    path=w.tour
    n=length(path)
    best=fill(typemax(Int), n+1)
    best[1]=0
    previous=zeros(Int, n+1)
    for j in 1:n, i in 0:(j-1)
        segment=path[(i+1):j]
        pathload(w, segment)>q && continue
        cost=best[i+1]+pathlength(w, segment)
        if cost<best[j+1]
            best[j+1]=cost
            previous[j+1]=i
        end
    end
    routes=Vector{Int}[]
    j=n
    while j>0
        i=previous[j+1]
        push!(routes, path[(i+1):j])
        j=i
    end
    w.capacity=q
    w.routes=routes
    normalize!(w)
    planreport(w, "split: capacity $q")
end
function firstrelocation(w)
    routes=w.routes
    for (r, source) in enumerate(routes)
        around=[0; source; 0]
        for (p, id) in enumerate(source), (t, target) in enumerate(routes)
            t==r && continue
            pathload(w, target)+w.stops[id].demand<=w.capacity || continue
            near=[0; target; 0]
            removal=distance(w, around[p], id)+distance(w, id, around[p+2])-distance(
                w,
                around[p],
                around[p+2],
            )
            for j in 0:length(target)
                gain=removal-distance(w, near[j+1], id)-distance(w, id, near[j+2])+distance(
                    w,
                    near[j+1],
                    near[j+2],
                )
                gain>0 && return (r, p, t, j, gain)
            end
        end
    end
    nothing
end
function firstexchange(w)
    for r in 1:(length(w.routes)-1), t in (r+1):length(w.routes)
        a=w.routes[r]
        b=w.routes[t]
        total=pathlength(w, a)+pathlength(w, b)
        for p in eachindex(a), j in eachindex(b)
            shift=w.stops[b[j]].demand-w.stops[a[p]].demand
            pathload(w, a)+shift<=w.capacity && pathload(w, b)-shift<=w.capacity || continue
            firstpath=copy(a)
            secondpath=copy(b)
            firstpath[p]=b[j]
            secondpath[j]=a[p]
            gain=total-pathlength(w, firstpath)-pathlength(w, secondpath)
            gain>0 && return (r, p, t, j, gain)
        end
    end
    nothing
end
function firstcross(w)
    for r in 1:(length(w.routes)-1), t in (r+1):length(w.routes)
        a=w.routes[r]
        b=w.routes[t]
        arounda=[0; a; 0]
        aroundb=[0; b; 0]
        for i in 0:length(a), j in 0:length(b)
            pathload(w, [a[1:i]; b[(j+1):end]])<=w.capacity &&
            pathload(w, [b[1:j]; a[(i+1):end]])<=w.capacity || continue
            gain=distance(w, arounda[i+1], arounda[i+2])+distance(w, aroundb[j+1], aroundb[j+2])-distance(
                w,
                arounda[i+1],
                aroundb[j+2],
            )-distance(w, aroundb[j+1], arounda[i+2])
            gain>0 && return (r, i, t, j, gain)
        end
    end
    nothing
end
function improveplan!(w, kind)
    before=planlength(w)
    countbefore=length(w.routes)
    moves=0
    while true
        move=kind=="RELOCATE" ? firstrelocation(w) :
             kind=="EXCHANGE" ? firstexchange(w) : firstcross(w)
        move===nothing && break
        r, p, t, j, gain=move
        if kind=="RELOCATE"
            id=w.routes[r][p]
            after=j==0 ? "D" : string(w.routes[t][j])
            println("relocate $id from route $r to route $t after $after gain $gain")
            deleteat!(w.routes[r], p)
            insert!(w.routes[t], j+1, id)
        elseif kind=="EXCHANGE"
            a=w.routes[r][p]
            b=w.routes[t][j]
            println("exchange $a (route $r) with $b (route $t) gain $gain")
            w.routes[r][p]=b
            w.routes[t][j]=a
        else
            a=w.routes[r]
            b=w.routes[t]
            println(
                "cross route $r after $(p==0 ? "D" : string(a[p])) with route $t after $(j==0 ? "D" : string(b[j])) gain $gain",
            )
            w.routes[r]=[a[1:p]; b[(j+1):end]]
            w.routes[t]=[b[1:j]; a[(p+1):end]]
        end
        normalize!(w)
        moves+=1
    end
    counts=kind=="EXCHANGE" ? "" : "routes $countbefore -> $(length(w.routes)), "
    println("$(lowercase(kind)): moves $moves, $(counts)length $before -> $(planlength(w))")
end
function execute!(w, line)
    parts=String.(split(line, ' '))
    command=parts[1]
    args=parts[2:end]
    if command=="DEPOT"
        x, y=parse.(Int, args)
        w.depot=(x, y)
        println("depot at ($x,$y)")
    elseif command=="START"
        w.start=parsetime(args[1])
        println("start $(timetext(w.start))")
    elseif command=="STOP"
        id, x, y, demand, service=parse.(Int, args[1:5])
        check(!haskey(w.stops, id), "stop $id already exists")
        opening=-1
        closing=-1
        if length(args)==7
            opening=parsetime(args[6])
            closing=parsetime(args[7])
            check(opening<=closing, "invalid window")
        end
        w.stops[id]=Stop(x, y, demand, service, opening, closing)
        w.tour=nothing
        w.routes=nothing
        println("stop $id added")
    elseif command=="REMOVE"
        id=parse(Int, args[1])
        check(haskey(w.stops, id), "unknown stop $id")
        delete!(w.stops, id)
        w.tour!==nothing && filter!(!=(id), w.tour)
        if w.routes!==nothing
            for path in w.routes
                filter!(!=(id), path)
            end
            normalize!(w)
        end
        if isempty(w.stops)
            w.tour=nothing
            w.routes=nothing
        end
        println("stop $id removed")
    elseif command=="LIST"
        println(w.depot===nothing ? "depot none" : "depot ($(w.depot[1]),$(w.depot[2]))")
        println("start $(timetext(w.start))\nstops $(length(w.stops))")
        for id in stopids(w)
            stop=w.stops[id]
            window=stop.opening<0 ? "none" : timetext(stop.opening)*"-"*timetext(stop.closing)
            println(
                "$id at ($(stop.x),$(stop.y)) demand $(stop.demand) service $(stop.service) window $window",
            )
        end
    elseif command=="MATRIX"
        requiredepot(w)
        ids=[0; stopids(w)]
        table=[[placename(id); [string(distance(w, id, other)) for other in ids]] for id in ids]
        header=placename.(ids)
        width=maximum(length, [header; reduce(vcat, table)])
        println(join([repeat(" ", width); lpad.(header, width)], ' '))
        for row in table
            println(join(lpad.(row, width), ' '))
        end
    elseif command in ("ORDER", "NEAREST", "INSERTION", "EXACT", "BOUND", "VRP", "SWEEP")
        requiredepot(w)
        requirestops(w)
        if command=="ORDER"
            path=parse.(Int, args)
            for id in path
                check(haskey(w.stops, id), "unknown stop $id")
            end
            seen=Set{Int}()
            for id in path
                check(!(id in seen), "duplicate stop $id")
                push!(seen, id)
            end
            check(
                length(path)==length(w.stops),
                "order has $(length(path)) stops, expected $(length(w.stops))",
            )
            installtour!(w, "order", path)
        elseif command=="NEAREST"
            remaining=stopids(w)
            path=Int[]
            current=0
            while !isempty(remaining)
                chosen=remaining[argmin([(distance(w, current, id), id) for id in remaining])]
                push!(path, chosen)
                filter!(!=(chosen), remaining)
                current=chosen
            end
            installtour!(w, "nearest", path)
        elseif command=="INSERTION"
            remaining=stopids(w)
            path=Int[]
            while !isempty(remaining)
                around=[0; path; 0]
                _, id, j=minimum(
                    (
                        distance(w, around[j+1], id)+distance(w, id, around[j+2])-distance(
                            w,
                            around[j+1],
                            around[j+2],
                        ),
                        id,
                        j,
                    ) for id in remaining for j in 0:length(path)
                )
                insert!(path, j+1, id)
                filter!(!=(id), remaining)
            end
            installtour!(w, "insertion", path)
        elseif command=="EXACT"
            check(length(w.stops)<=10, "too many stops for exact ($(length(w.stops)))")
            installtour!(w, "exact", exacttour(w))
        elseif command=="BOUND"
            ids=stopids(w)
            edges=spanningtree(w, [0; ids])
            mst=sum(e[3] for e in edges)
            println(
                "mst: ",
                join(["$(placename(a))-$b" for (a, b, _) in edges], ' '),
                " (length $mst)",
            )
            distances=sort([distance(w, 0, id) for id in ids])
            one=length(ids)==1 ? 2distances[1] :
                sum(e[3] for e in spanningtree(w, ids))+distances[1]+distances[2]
            best=max(mst, one)
            println("bound: mst $mst, one-tree $one, best $best")
            if w.tour===nothing
                println("gap: no tour")
            else
                total=pathlength(w, w.tour)
                gap=best==0 ? 0 : div(2000*(total-best)+best, 2best)
                println("gap: tour $total, $(tenths(gap))%")
            end
        else
            q=parse(Int, args[1])
            requirecapacity(w, q)
            if command=="VRP"
                savings!(w, q, length(args)==2 ? parse(Int, args[2]) : nothing)
            else
                routes=[Int[]]
                used=0
                for id in sweeporder(w)
                    demand=w.stops[id].demand
                    if used+demand>q
                        push!(routes, Int[])
                        used=0
                    end
                    push!(last(routes), id)
                    used+=demand
                end
                w.capacity=q
                w.routes=routes
                normalize!(w)
                planreport(w, "sweep: capacity $q")
            end
        end
    elseif command=="TOUR"
        requiretour(w)
        println("tour: $(notation(w.tour)) length $(pathlength(w,w.tour))")
    elseif command in ("TWOOPT", "OROPT", "SWAP")
        requiretour(w)
        before=pathlength(w, w.tour)
        moves=0
        if command=="TWOOPT"
            moves=twoopt!(w, w.tour)
        else
            while true
                move=command=="OROPT" ? firstsegment(w, w.tour) : firstswap(w, w.tour)
                move===nothing && break
                if command=="OROPT"
                    i, size, j, gain=move
                    segment=w.tour[i:(i+size-1)]
                    rest=[w.tour[1:(i-1)]; w.tour[(i+size):end]]
                    println(
                        "move $(join(segment,'-')) after $(j==0 ? "D" : string(rest[j])) gain $gain",
                    )
                    w.tour=[rest[1:j]; segment; rest[(j+1):end]]
                else
                    i, j, gain=move
                    println("swap $(w.tour[i]) and $(w.tour[j]) gain $gain")
                    w.tour[i], w.tour[j]=w.tour[j], w.tour[i]
                end
                moves+=1
            end
        end
        println("$(lowercase(command)): moves $moves, length $before -> $(pathlength(w,w.tour))")
    elseif command=="TIMECHECK"
        if isempty(args)
            requiretour(w)
            path=w.tour
            println("timecheck tour depart $(timetext(w.start))")
        else
            requireplan(w)
            r=parse(Int, args[1])
            check(r<=length(w.routes), "no route $r")
            path=w.routes[r]
            println("timecheck route $r depart $(timetext(w.start))")
        end
        run=simulate(w, path)
        for (id, arrival, wait, beginning, leave, late) in run.visits
            println(
                "$id arrive $(timetext(arrival)) wait $wait begin $(timetext(beginning)) leave $(timetext(leave)) $(late>0 ? "late $late" : "ok")",
            )
        end
        println(
            "return $(timetext(run.finish)), travel $(run.travel), wait $(run.wait), service $(run.service), violations $(run.violations), lateness $(run.lateness)",
        )
    elseif command=="SPLIT"
        requiretour(w)
        q=parse(Int, args[1])
        requirecapacity(w, q)
        splitplan!(w, q)
    elseif command=="ROUTES"
        requireplan(w)
        planreport(w, "plan: capacity $(w.capacity)")
    elseif command in ("RELOCATE", "EXCHANGE", "CROSS")
        requireplan(w)
        improveplan!(w, command)
    elseif command=="ROUTEOPT"
        requireplan(w)
        before=planlength(w)
        for (r, path) in enumerate(w.routes)
            old=pathlength(w, path)
            moves=twoopt!(w, path; display = false)
            println("route $r: moves $moves, length $old -> $(pathlength(w,path))")
        end
        normalize!(w)
        println("routeopt: length $before -> $(planlength(w))")
    elseif command=="REPORT"
        println(
            "report: stops $(length(w.stops)), demand $(sum((s.demand for s in values(w.stops));init=0)), service $(sum((s.service for s in values(w.stops));init=0)), windows $(count(s->s.opening>=0,values(w.stops)))",
        )
        if w.tour===nothing
            println("tour: none")
        else
            run=simulate(w, w.tour)
            println(
                "tour: length $(run.travel), return $(timetext(run.finish)), violations $(run.violations), lateness $(run.lateness)",
            )
        end
        if w.routes===nothing
            println("plan: none")
        else
            runs=[simulate(w, path) for path in w.routes]
            k=length(w.routes)
            total=sum(pathload(w, path) for path in w.routes)
            utilization=div(2000total+k*w.capacity, 2k*w.capacity)
            println(
                "plan: capacity $(w.capacity), routes $k, length $(planlength(w)), utilization $(tenths(utilization))%, return $(timetext(maximum(r.finish for r in runs))), violations $(sum(r.violations for r in runs)), lateness $(sum(r.lateness for r in runs))",
            )
        end
    end
end
function main()
    workbench=Workbench()
    n=parse(Int, readline())
    for _ in 1:n
        line=readline()
        try
            execute!(workbench, line)
        catch e
            e isa CommandError || rethrow()
            println("error: $(e.message)")
        end
    end
end
main()
